NfrOrgNode.title: NFR Organization Node
NfrOrgNode.description: Represents a division or workshop under Northeast Frontier Railway in the organization map.

id.description: The custom identifier (e.g. kir, apdj, rny, lmg, tsk, nbq, dbws, ews)

x.description: X coordinate on the SVG map (0 to 100)

y.description: Y coordinate on the SVG map (0 to 80)

DarPosition.title: DAR Position of Personnel Branch
DarPosition.description: Represents a Discipline & Appeal Rules register item in the excel sheet of the Personnel Branch

DarHqCase.title: DAR HQ Case Docket
DarHqCase.description: Represents a case checklist and page indexes for HQ submissions

Part2Field.title: Checklist Row Template Field
Part2Field.description: Represents a templated question/checklist item dynamically editable in Checklist Settings

PendingSFDraft.title: Standard Form Draft
PendingSFDraft.description: Autosaved draft of fully and partially completed standard forms

CustomSecStamp.title: Custom Office Stamp
CustomSecStamp.description: Admin uploaded transparent stamp or signature image saved securely in firestore

TaClaim.title: Traveling Allowance Claim
TaClaim.description: Traveling Allowance Claim for railway employees containing general information and journey legs.

CustomStation.title: Custom Station
CustomStation.description: Railway station code and name dynamically registered by the user stored in the cloud firestore database.

CustomTrain.title: Custom Train Record
CustomTrain.description: User uploaded train records containing train number, name, and optional route/via station description.

ApoAllottedEmployee.title: APO Allotted Employee
ApoAllottedEmployee.description: Employees assigned to a specific department or section allot under an APO officer, with their hierarchy status.

/custom_stations/{stationId}.description: Custom station codes and names registered dynamically.

/custom_trains/{trainId}.description: Registered and uploaded train numbers and details.

/nfrOrgNodes/{nodeId}.description: Collections of NFR divisions and workshops displayed in the Interactive Organization Map.

/dar_positions/{positionId}.description: Detailed position statements for the Discipline & Appeal Rules of the Personnel Branch

/dar_hq_cases/{caseId}.description: Checklist and index register for DAR compliance filings ready for HQ submission

/part2Template/{fieldId}.description: Dynamic HQ materials checklist form row configurations

/pending_sf_drafts/{draftId}.description: Dynamic collection of standard form drafts auto-saved every 5 seconds

/sec_office_stamps/{stampId}.description: Uploaded signatures and divisional stamps available across the system

/ta_claims/{claimId}.description: Traveling Allowance Claims saved by the application with nested journey legs and calculations.

/apo_allotted_employees/{empId}.description: Information on which junior and senior personnel work under each APO allotted branch.
